scenicChapters.title: Pacific Coast Highway, California State Route 1
scenicChapters.narrative: For 55 km this is Pacific Coast Highway, California State Route 1, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it — expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast.

facts.v: Pacific Coast Highway, California State Route 1

scenicChapters.title: Pacific Coast Highway, California State Route 1
scenicChapters.narrative: Water arrives beside the road and stays for 17 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go. Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did.

facts.v: Pacific Coast Highway, California State Route 1

california-big-sur-highway-1-dream-secti.story: 329 km from Carmel Valley Village to the finish, about 5 h 02 of riding. It goes by way of Big Sur village and Pfeiffer coast. Back roads rather than main roads, where the map allows.
